title: History ordering and next-check time
description: A history list is a stack of dated events. Trace how a service response becomes a row, how newest checks are selected, and how a due timestamp is calculated. Notice that no history means “No check yet.”
learning_objectives: Explain tocheck, lastcheck, formatting, interval calculation, and empty state in plain language.
Trace export function nextCheckDue in `src/exposure.ts` and explain the relevant behavior.
State and preserve this limit: The configured interval is a UI rule, not health guidance.
